title: Structuring HTML Tables
ques: Explain the semantic components of an HTML table: `<table>`, `<thead>`, `<tbody>`, `<tfoot>`, `<tr>`, and `<td>`.

answer.content:
Product Item Unit Price
Wireless Mouse $25.00
Mechanical Keyboard $75.00
Total Balance $100.00

explanation: Separating tables into `<thead>`, `<tbody>`, and `<tfoot>` provides logical structure, allowing screen readers and print styles to repeat table headers across pages.

title: Accessible Table Headers with Scope
ques: Explain why **`<th>`** elements should use the **`scope`** attribute (`col` or `row`) for screen reader accessibility.

answer.content:
Student Name Exam Score Grade
Alice Johnson 95 A
Bob Martinez 82 B

explanation: The `scope` attribute explicitly establishes whether a header cell applies to a column (`col`) or a row (`row`), providing crucial context to screen reader users as they navigate individual data cells.

title: Adding Descriptive Table Captions
ques: Explain the purpose of the **`<caption>`** element and demonstrate its correct placement within an HTML table.

answer.content:
Monthly Employee Attendance and Overtime Hours (Q3 2026)
Employee ID Department Overtime Hours
EMP-401 Engineering 14

explanation: `<caption>` provides an accessible title or description summarizing the table's contents and purpose. It must be the immediate first child of the `<table>` element.

title: Spanning Cells with Colspan and Rowspan
ques: Demonstrate how to merge table cells across columns using **`colspan`** and across rows using **`rowspan`** in a class schedule table.

answer.content:
Weekly Lecture Timetable
Time Slot Monday Tuesday
09:00 - 11:00 Computer Science Lab Mathematics
11:00 - 12:00 Physics
12:00 - 13:00 Lunch Break (Campus Cafeteria)

explanation: `colspan="N"` merges a cell horizontally across N columns. `rowspan="N"` merges a cell vertically down across N rows.
